findings.current: The countless lives it had once been able to count in the thousands were nowhere to be found.
findings.defect: Changes roughly a thousand lives to thousands of lives.
findings.rationale: 일천을 헤아리던 indicates a count around one thousand, not multiple thousands.
findings.replacement: The lives that had once numbered around a thousand were nowhere to be found.
findings.source: 일천을 헤아리던 수많은 생명은 어디에도 없다.

findings.current: The Grand Mage who had once been hailed as a hero was losing his mana, his memories, and the precious vitality he had so carefully saved, like water receding with the tide.
findings.defect: Makes the Grand Mage the person actively losing his reserves, rather than presenting his stolen mana, memories, and vitality as draining from the Doppelganger.
findings.rationale: The Doppelganger feels those resources leave as the soul binding breaks and its borrowed life ends.
findings.replacement: The mana, memories, and carefully hoarded vitality of the Grand Mage once hailed as a hero were draining away like the tide.
findings.source: 한때 영웅으로 칭송받던 대마도사의 마나가, 기억이, 아끼고 아껴 왔던 귀중한 생명력이 썰물처럼 빠져나가는 것을.

findings.defect: Supplies a specific thought about Jin’s struggle that the source deliberately leaves unsaid.
findings.rationale: 겨우 이런 놈한테 trails off before stating what was done by or suffered at the hands of this being; Jin swallows the rest of the thought.

findings.current: And how hot the flames that burst from the spearhead and entered its body.
findings.defect: Makes the flames enter the body; in the source, the spearhead has driven into the body and flames burst from it.
findings.rationale: 몸 안을 파고든 modifies 창날, not the flames.
findings.replacement: And how hot the flames bursting from the spearhead buried in its body.
findings.source: 반면 몸 안을 파고든 창날에서 터져 나온 불길은 어찌나 뜨겁던지.

findings.current: Its last ticket out of this place had just sold out.
findings.rationale: 마지막 비행기의 티켓 explicitly makes this an airline-ticket metaphor.
findings.replacement: The ticket for the last flight out of here had just sold out.
findings.source: 이 자리를 빠져나갈 수 있는 마지막 비행기의 티켓이, 지금 막 매진됐다는 것을.

findings.current: Its body regenerated in an instant, like the magic beansprout from an old fairy tale.
findings.defect: Renders a towering fairy-tale beanstalk as a beansprout.
findings.rationale: 콩 나무 refers to the beanstalk image, not a sprout.
findings.replacement: Its body regenerated in an instant, like a beanstalk shooting up in an old fairy tale.
findings.source: 마치 옛 동화 속에 등장하는 콩 나무처럼 순식간에 재생된 신체.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it changes the scale of the Doppelganger’s remaining lives, obscures whose stolen reserves are draining away, and completes a thought the source leaves unfinished.
